response.title: which solar generator has the longest lasting battery in years
response.answer:
If you're looking for a solar generator whose battery lasts the most years before needing replacement, I recommend focusing on models with LiFePO4 (lithium iron phosphate) batteries.

The best long-life solar generators can potentially last 10–15 years or longer, depending on how frequently you use them, battery temperature, and charging habits.

There are two important specifications:

Cycle life: How many full-equivalent charge/discharge cycles the battery can handle before dropping to a specified capacity, usually 70% or 80%.

Calendar life: How many years the battery lasts even if you rarely use it.

A battery rated for 6,000 cycles isn't necessarily going to last twice as many years as one rated for 3,000 cycles. Calendar aging matters too.
